title: scripts/moe-serena-ignore.mjs: build a Serena ignore override from git's own ignore sources (producer for task-e3e81c45)
definitionOfDone: Against a fixture git repo whose big/ (holding nested .gitignore files) is excluded only in .git/info/exclude, with a tracked sub/.gitignore and a .serena/project.yml that sets ignored_paths, the script writes a .serena/project.local.yml whose content equals the expected text exactly. That text is: the walk off; "/.git" first; project.yml's entries; then the info/exclude pattern for big/ and the root and nested .gitignore patterns, converted as Serena converts them. A rerun prints the up-to-date line and leaves the file's bytes and inode unchanged. scripts/tests/serena-ignore.test.mjs proves it.

An existing project.local.yml keeps every byte outside the Moe block, and a previous block is replaced, never duplicated. MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_OVERRIDE=0, or a user part that sets ignore_all_files_in_gitignore or ignored_paths, removes a previous block and writes nothing else. Each of these is a test row.

Fail-open, one test row each: a non-git root; a subdirectory root; a broken repository (a .git file naming a missing gitdir); no git on PATH; MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 without an absolute MOE_PROTECTED_GIT; a project.local.yml that git does not ignore, and a tracked one; a symlinked project.local.yml; a begin marker without its end; an unreadable project.yml ignored_paths; a submodule; an untracked nested repository. Each prints MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_SKIPPED, exits 0, and leaves the root's files byte-identical.

The script is ESM with `#!/usr/bin/env node` and a short header comment (purpose, usage, the three output lines, the opt-outs). It imports node: builtins only (node:fs, node:os, node:path, node:child_process, node:crypto, node:url). It exports three pure functions that step 3's CLI uses.

(a) convertGitignore(text, relDir, platform = process.platform) -> string[]. It is an exact mirror of Serena 1.6.2's GitignoreParser._parse_gitignore_content (serena/util/file_system.py:216-291 under ~/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent/lib/python3.12/site-packages). relDir is the .gitignore's directory relative to the root with '/' separators, or '' for a root-level file.
- Split lines like Python str.splitlines(): /\r\n|[\n\x0b\x0c\r\x1c\x1d\x1e\x85  ]/.
- Every strip uses Python's str.isspace() set: [\t\n\x0b\x0c\r\x1c-\x1f \x85\xa0  -     　]. U+FEFF is NOT whitespace.
- rstrip the line. Drop it when it is empty or when its lstrip starts with '#'.
- Remove a leading '!' and remember it, then strip; drop the line if it is now empty.
- A leading '\#' or '\!' loses its backslash.
- A leading '/' marks the line anchored and is removed.
- Root: an anchored line becomes '/' + line; any other stays as is.
- Nested: an anchored line, or one starting with '**/', becomes join(relDir, line); any other becomes join(join(relDir, '**'), line).
- join mirrors posixpath/ntpath.join: a rooted second part replaces the first. Rooted means it starts with '/'; on win32 it also means a leading '\', or ':' as its second character.
- Put the '!' back. On win32 replace every '\' with '/' (Serena's replace(os.sep, '/')).

(b) parseIgnoredPaths(text) -> string[], or null when it cannot be read safely (the CLI then skips). It returns project.yml's top-level ignored_paths as Serena's ruamel loader reads it.
- Strip a leading U+FEFF, and each line's trailing '\r'.
- Only a column-0 key counts (ignored_paths, optionally quoted). No key -> []. Two keys -> null.
- After the colon (a trailing ' #...' comment is allowed):
  - nothing: a block sequence follows. Skip blank and comment-only lines. Items are `<indent>- <scalar>` at one constant space indent (column 0 allowed). The first column-0 line that is not an item ends the sequence. Any other indented line (a continuation), a tab in the indent, or a bare '-' -> null. No items -> [] (Serena maps null to []).
  - `[]` -> []. A one-line flow sequence like `[a, "b", 'c''d']` -> its items. An unclosed or multi-line flow, an empty item or a trailing comma -> null.
  - anything else (a scalar, anchor, alias, tag, '|' or '>') -> null.
- A scalar is accepted only as one of these; anything else -> null:
  - a double-quoted string that JSON.parse reads (a YAML-only escape like \x41, or a raw tab, -> null);
  - a single-quoted string ('' -> ');
  - a plain scalar matching /^(?:[A-Za-z_\/]|\.(?![0-9]))[\w.\/*?+=@~ -]*$/ after trimming a trailing ' #...' comment and whitespace, that is not a YAML null, bool or number word (null, true, false, yes, no, on, off, y, n in their YAML case forms, .inf, .nan).
- U3 is one table:
  - [] for `ignored_paths: []`, for no key, and for `ignored_paths:` alone;
  - the values for block items at column 0 and indented, holding plain, double-quoted and single-quoted scalars with a trailing comment, and for the one-line flow form;
  - null for each of `- *alias`, `- !tag x`, `- &a x`, `- 123`, `- true`, `- ~`, `- |`, an indented continuation line, `[a, b`, `[a, ]`, a duplicate key, `- "bad\x41"` and a bare `-`.

(c) renderBlock(patterns) -> the managed block: LF, ending in '\n', with step 2's exact lines.
- Each pattern line is `  - ` + JSON.stringify(p).
- Then every U+007F-U+009F, U+2028, U+2029, U+FEFF, U+FFFE and U+FFFF is written as a \uXXXX escape. YAML forbids those characters raw, and a file ruamel refuses breaks Serena's project load.
- U4: renderBlock(['q"\\', 'a\u007fb', '﻿x']) renders the three items as JSON.stringify does, except that U+007F and U+FEFF become the literal six-character escapes \u007f and ﻿.

Error handling: these functions never throw on string input. null is the refusal, which the CLI turns into a skip. Importing the module must not run the CLI: guard main with the realpath-compare invokedDirectly() idiom of scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs:579-596.

- `[info] MOE_SERENA_IGNORE_OVERRIDE: <file> is up to date (<n> patterns)`

1. No argv[0] -> access `usage: node moe-serena-ignore.mjs <serena-root>`. If root is not a directory -> access `<root> is not a directory`.
2. lstat <file>.

3. Markers: either none, or exactly one begin line followed later by exactly one end line. Anything else -> access `<file> has Moe block markers that do not pair`. before = the text up to the begin line, after = the text after the end line, and user = before + after.
